title: When Graph meets Multimodal: Benchmarking and Meditating on Multimodal Attributed Graphs Learning

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the performance of Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) using single-modal (text-only or vision-only) versus multimodal embeddings, particularly in few-shot learning scenarios, to observe if models disproportionately favor one modality over another and fail to effectively leverage heterogeneous attributes.
